transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion S-6. I'll be publishing the binding network access plan for tomorrow once the change-control board gets the service requirements from operations, logistics, and medical. We have three network segments available -- Red, Blue, and Green -- and three service windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Each service will receive one segment and one window. Before we finalize assignments, I need each of you to provide your service requirements. Also note that each service must have a documented configuration control completed before its assigned access window begins. Who'd like to start?
